description: 15条跨硬件 Qwen 推理优化案例：严格分离实测/微基准/配置/提案，并保留输入形状、版本与数值限制。本研究无任何实机测量。
comparison_warning: 不同模型/硬件/负载/阶段绝不可直接比较性能百分比

cases.name: 得物：昇腾 910C Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 低并发推理
cases.hardware: Ascend 910C / TP2 (文章包含 560t/752t 各阶段)
cases.workload: online decode c=1/4/8; 1024 in / 512 out, random and business datasets differ by stage
cases.outcome: c=1 TPOT 14.22ms → 5.0ms in author's final setup (64.8% lower); not like-for-like across every intervening step
cases.notes: 原作者源码内部分支未确认公开；硬件版本/数据集在阶段间有变化；不能断言统一可复现 64.8%

cases.name: SGLang Qwen3-Coder-Next：FlashInfer AllReduce 融合
cases.workload: random 2048 input / 256 output; 128 prompts; max concurrency 32
cases.outcome: request throughput 5.49→9.41 req/s (+71.4%); mean TTFT 456.24→167.54ms; mean TPOT 50.41→25.49ms
cases.notes: 后续确定性推理存在回归并有禁用融合的修复 PR #24629；不能直接移植到 Ascend

cases.name: vLLM Qwen3.5-397B：QKNorm/RoPE/Post-Conv 融合
cases.hardware: NVIDIA Blackwell Ultra (文章部署配置)
cases.workload: reported concurrency=1 and concurrency=256, model-specific production workload
cases.outcome: 163 tok/s at c1; 6.69→7.33 req/s at c256 (+~10%) after combined tuning
cases.notes: 多个改动叠加，整体吞吐提升不能归因到单一融合；不同模型形状适用性需检查

cases.name: FlashInfer + vLLM：Qwen3.5 Blackwell GDN Prefill Kernel
cases.workload: prefill-only 8192 input / 1 output; varied shapes in microbench
cases.outcome: GDN kernel microbench up to 5.92×; end-to-end prefill throughput 1.13×; mean TTFT -12%
cases.notes: Kernel 微基准最高倍数≠整体推理倍数；基于 Blackwell/CUDA，不等于昇腾 AscendC 实现

cases.name: 腾讯 HPC-Ops × SGLang：Qwen3 Fused MoE
cases.model: Qwen3 (benchmark shapes; not a single checkpoint)
cases.hardware: NVIDIA H200 (Qwen3 microbench); H20 for other deployments
cases.workload: Qwen3/H200 microbenchmark, 8 tokens; Hy3 separately in online-serving workload
cases.outcome: Qwen3/H200 MoE kernel speedup up to 4.21× vs Triton at 8 tokens; Hy3 TPOT gains must not be attributed to Qwen3
cases.notes: Qwen3 对比为算子级微基准；算子提升不能直接作为端到端 TPS 改善

cases.name: Google Ironwood：Qwen3.5-397B 模块化算子优化
cases.workload: prefill-heavy and decode-heavy; report uses concurrency 512
cases.outcome: reported approximately 3.1× decode-heavy and 4.7× prefill-heavy throughput vs prior April baseline (June 2026, concurrency 512)
cases.notes: 模块化设计理念可借鉴，但 TPM/Pallas 内核不可直接移植到 AscendC；对照为跨月份持续迭代

cases.name: MLX：Qwen3.6-35B-A3B Q4 Gate/Up 融合
cases.workload: batch-one text decode, local frozen benchmark suite
cases.outcome: median decode +2.768%; some attempted fusions rejected because negative or numerical changes
cases.notes: 社区小型研究，数据为作者自测；Metal Q4 与 910C BF16 实现不可直接互换

cases.name: SGLang：Qwen3 MoE Triton 算子调优工具链
cases.workload: operator-level TP/EP tuning, no single benchmark shape asserted here
cases.notes: 工具存在不等于性能结论，优先借鉴矩阵形状与测试用例

cases.name: SGLang AMD MI300X Qwen3-Next 性能优化追踪提案
cases.notes: 文中若出现预期 15-20%、2x 等目标必须标为 proposed，绝非已测表现

cases.name: TensorRT-LLM Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B：MTP3 受控接受率试验
cases.hardware: NVIDIA GB300; 16 GPUs; TP16/EP1 for latency; attention DP32/EP32 32 GPUs for throughput
cases.workload: 8192 input / 1024 output tokens; latency concurrency 1; MTP accepted-draft count fixed at 2.3
cases.outcome: Low-latency non-MTP 133.502 output tok/s/user (7.491ms median TPOT) versus MTP3 383.051 output tok/s/user (2.611ms); controlled accepted-draft count 2.3, not naturally sampled traffic
cases.notes: 明确需要记录 synthetic/controlled acceptance，不能视为线上真实接受率；低延迟与高吞吐测试拓扑、并发不同，禁止合并计算倍数

cases.name: TensorRT-LLM MoE Perf Guide：Qwen3.8 专家路由与微基准/线上落差
cases.hardware: GB300/B300; other models also studied on GB200
cases.workload: module-level bench_moe with perfectly balanced expert routing; production routing may be skewed
cases.notes: 指南对其他模型的交叉验证发现真实路由不均可使完美路由微基准排名失效；不能将其统计直接归属 Qwen3.8；不宣称具体 Qwen3.8 加速百分比

cases.name: TileOPs Qwen3 MoE：固定形状 30B/235B 算子微基准
cases.model: Qwen3-30B and Qwen3-235B benchmark shapes (not single end-to-end serving job)
cases.hardware: GPU test device not fixed in cited table; refer to benchmark calibration records
cases.outcome: FusedMoEFwd qwen3-30b-decode-b1 BF16 0.0396ms vs fastest listed vLLM 0.0413ms (~1.04x, site calls 0.95-1.05x level/noise); grouped GEMM qwen3-30b-ep8-decode 0.0213ms vs torch-grouped-mm 0.0320ms (1.51x); device-only times
cases.notes: 网站把 1.04x 归为统计噪声范围而非显著收益；测试仅算子设备时长，不含 CPU 调度/在线请求，GPU 型号须从校准记录复核

cases.name: vLLM Intel XPU：Qwen3.5 GDN/RMSNorm 优化规划及追踪
cases.hardware: Intel XPU / SYCL (issue does not fix one model/hardware benchmark)
cases.workload: GDN l2norm, chunk_fwd_o, causal conv1d, grouped GEMM; roadmap items
cases.notes: 此 issue 为任务跟踪汇总，不表示所有子 PR 已合并或有端到端加速；各子 PR 要单独核查状态与 Benchmark

cases.name: vLLM Speculators：Qwen3-Next/Qwen3.5 原生 MTP 的领域微调方法
cases.model: Qwen3-Next / Qwen3.5 models with native MTP head
cases.hardware: hardware-independent training recipe; deployment hardware not measured here
cases.workload: convert existing MTP head -> fine-tune on domain data -> stitch; no Qwen benchmark numbers cited in method page
cases.notes: 训练仅 MTP 层，冻结 embed_tokens 与 LM head；需要另测 acceptance length、TTFT、TPOT，方法说明不等于加速测量

cases.name: TensorRT-LLM Qwen3.5：吞吐型部署参数配方与算子后端
cases.workload: high-throughput-oriented 4xB200, max batch 512, max_num_tokens 2048, TP4/EP4, attention DP
cases.notes: 这是一份配置参考而非保证最优性能的测量；不同芯片、模型量化格式和负载不能直接沿用 batch/cache 配置
